# ngon-junk

ngon-junk is a free open-source creative utility for fast 3D model preview, material look development and reliable export passes without a heavy production suite.

Lightweight desktop 3D look-dev tool for model preview, material testing, UV tweaks, image/model export and turntable capture.

Creator: Ali Guzel
Publisher: YCSWU
License: Open source
Website: https://ycswu.co/ngon-junk/
GitHub: https://github.com/aliguzel996/ngon-junk
Release API: https://api.github.com/repos/aliguzel996/ngon-junk/releases/latest
Windows portable: https://github.com/aliguzel996/ngon-junk/releases/latest/download/ngon-junk-1.1.1-latest.exe
Setup: https://github.com/aliguzel996/ngon-junk/releases/latest/download/ngon-junk-setup-1.1.1.exe

Input formats: OBJ, FBX, 3DS, STL, BLEND, SKP
Output formats: GLB, OBJ, JPG, PNG, GIF, ZIP
Platforms: Windows
